contracts.name: Bones by the Old Bridge
contracts.description: Gravebound have risen beyond the bridge. Put three to rest and bring back their bones.

contracts.name: Bone Harvest
contracts.description: Bram always needs Gravebound bone. Steady work for a steady hunter.

contracts.name: The Grave Warden
contracts.description: Something commands the Gravebound from the crypt beneath the ruined tower. End it, and break its helm so all can see.

contracts.name: The Beast of Blackmoor
contracts.description: Travellers speak of a great wolf that walks like a man on the northern moors.

prerequisites.label: The beast has not been sighted yet.

contracts.name: Thorns at the Timberline
contracts.description: Hunt Thornback in Thornwood Clearing. Break a tusk and bring down the bark-armored beast.

contracts.name: Venom on the Riverbank
contracts.description: Mirejaw stalks Mirewater Bank. Watch the swollen sacs before its venom spray; breaking both removes the spray.

quests.name: Rise of the Estate
quests.description: From a leaking cottage to a name the valley knows.

stages.description: Mira the herbalist has work. Find her at Thornbury Crossing.
Put the Gravebound by the Old Bridge to rest.
Bring the bones to Bram and forge a better blade.
Descend into the crypt and face the Grave Warden.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Oh! You must be the hunter who took the old cottage. I'm Mira. I keep the herb stall here at the crossing. The dead have been walking near the Old Bridge again.

choices.text: I'm a hunter. I can deal with them.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Back in one piece, {player}? What do you need?

choices.text: About the Gravebound by the bridge...
The bridge is clear. Here are the bones.
May I use your mortar and pestle?
Would you walk with me one evening?
Let's not wait. Marry me at the cottage.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Three of them at least, between the bridge and the ash fields. Bring back their bones so the village knows they're truly down. We pooled sixty gold.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Be careful. They raise their blades before they strike, and their eyes flare red. Step aside, then answer. Their helms crack if you aim high.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: You did it! Here, the village's gold, and two of my tonics. Take those bones to Bram at the forge. He can make you a blade that bites the dead.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: The ruined tower past the graves has a crypt beneath it. Something down there keeps the dead walking. Break its helm and they'll believe you at court.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: The bells in Ashgrove rang this morning. They're saying your name, {player}.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Thornbury is just a crossing: my stall, Bram's forge and the hunt board. Past the ash fields is the old crypt. Lady Elowen speaks for the court at Ashgrove; she rarely notices folk like us.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: I... I'd like that. Meet me by the garden at dusk.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Yes. A thousand times yes. Is there room at the cottage for my herbs?

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: Then it's settled. I'll bring my garden to the cottage. It's our home now.

nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.text: There you are, love. The garden at home is thriving. What do you need?

choices.text: The bridge is clear. Here are the bones.
May I use your mortar and pestle?

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Bram. I work iron. Need something forged, or something to build with?

choices.text: Here are the bones you wanted.
What can you make from Gravebound bone?

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Bone dust folded into steel makes an edge the dead remember. Ribs make a fair vest, if you've grave iron to bind them. Bring me the Warden's iron someday and I'll make you a helm.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Six shards a day, every day, and I'll pay fair. The board will track it for you.

nodes.speaker: Lady Elowen
nodes.text: The court of Ashgrove receives hunters of standing. Come back when your name means something, and when you have a roof worth the name.

choices.text: I am a Silver Hunter, with an estate of my own.

nodes.speaker: Lady Elowen
nodes.text: Welcome to the court's favour, hunter. Ashgrove will send for you when it has work worthy of your blade.

entryRequirements.label: The crypt door is sealed. Only a Bronze Hunter could convince the village to unbar it.
